senses.gloss: (I)--son of Viraja and father of Ketuman (शत- jit, वि। प्।). Br. II. १४. ७०; III. 8. १९; Vi. II. 1. ४०.
(II)--son of Dhara. Br. III. 3. २२.
(III)--is राजसीवृत्ति: Leads to duhkha and तृष. Br. IV. 3. ३२-41.
(IV)--one of the seven sons of वसिष्ठ and ऊर्जा; wife मार्कण्डेयी and son Ketuman. वा. २८. ३६-37; Vi. I. १०. १३.
(V)--the quality present both in तमस् and सत्व as oil in the oil-seed and ghee in milk; it is the result of agitation in the प्रधान। वा. 3. 2; 5. १०, १२.
(VI)--son of Arija; a राजऋषि and tapassiddha. वा. ३३. ६०; ५७. १२२.
(VII)--one of the ten branches of the Rohita clan of devas. वा. १००. ९०. [page३-045+ ३०]
(I)--one of the ten branches of the Rohita clan of devas. Br. IV. 1. ८६; वा. १००. ९०.

(II)--(see also राजन्) qualifications of: should not retreat from the battle-field; should protect Brahmanas, the poor and the helpless; insist on svadharma of his sub- jects, aid tapasvins, befriend the truthful and avoid the vakras;
1: M. २१५. ५६-99; २३८. १२.
precautions to be observed; befriend enemy's sub- jects and provide them with jobs; use spies in administra- tion;
2: Ib. २२०. 8-४७.
prescriptions for personal conduct and successful rule of a king; some व्रतम्स् like the आग्नेय, पार्थिव, etc.
3: Ib. २२३. 7f.
Avoid the two kinds of discontent,--अन्तह्कोप and बहिह्- कोप; the former brings more ruin it being towards the mem- [page३-063+ ३२] bers of the royal household; the latter towards सामन्तस्.
4: Ib. २२६. 3-१२.
Collect taxes through faithful servants annually.
5: Ib. २१५. ५७.
Earn the title of राजऋषि like ययाति;
6: Ib. १३. ६२; ४३. २३; ४६. २८.
ety. of.
7: वा 62. १३४; १०९. ५४.

--a washerman;
1: M. १९२. २०.
शुक्लतीर्थम्, compared to, in washing sins; to be fined a माष of gold by the king for not properly washing.
2: Ib. २२७. १५५.
the washerman of Kamsa was killed on his refusing cloths to कृष्ण and राम.
3: Vi. V. १९. १४-17.
--son of विशाखयूप, and father of Nandivar- dhana, the Magadha king. भा. XII. 1. 3-4.
--son of Varatri. Br. III. 1. ७९.

--a दान; also रौप्याचलम्; the best gift is of १०,000 palams of silver; the giver goes to the world of the moon; then of 5,००० and then 2,५०० palams; anything above २० palams. M. ८३. 6; ९१. 1ff. [page३-064+ ३३]
(I)--the milkman of the यक्षस् on the earth and father of मणिधर. Born of यक्ष and apsaras क्रतुस्थला. Br. II. ३६. २१६; III. 7. १११.
(II)--the grandfather of the यक्षस्, mar- ried भद्रा, the daughter of अनुह्राद, the Daitya; father of मणिभद्र and मणिवर; wives of these two become the aunts of सम्सिद्धकरण. वा. ६९. १५१-2.
--silver, came out of शिव's eyes; hence dear to पितृस्; but inauspicious and to be avoided in देवकार्यस्. M. १७. २२-3.
--a R. in शाल्मलिद्वीप. भा. V. २०. १०.

--son of आयु and father of five hundred (hundred म्।प्।) sons known as Rajeyas; a devotee of नारायण; was invested with conquering powers; fearing प्रह्लाद and other enemies, Indra gave his kingdom to Raji; once when the देवासुर (कोलाहल) war broke out between प्रह्लाद and Indra extending for ३०० years both parties invoked his assistance; he joined the Devas who unlike the Asuras [page३-046+ २९] accepted him as their Lord and he vanquished the Asuras; Indra became thus his adopted son to whom he gave back his kingdom and returned to forest for penance. Indra, however, returned the kingdom to Raji; after Raji's death his sons appropriated the kingdom and refused to give it to Indra; the latter therefore killed all of them with the help of बृहस्पति.
1: भा. IX. १७. 1-१६; Br. III. ६७. 2, ७९-105; ७२. ८६; M. २४. ३५-42; वा. ९७. ८६; Vi. IV. 8. 3, २१; 9. 1-२३.
It is said where Raji is, there लक्ष्मी finds her abode; where लक्ष्मी is there धृति lives; where धृति resides, धाम lives; where धाम lives, there is Jaya.
2: वा. ९२. ७४-99.
--one of the ten sons of रौद्राश्व. वा. ९९. १२४.

--a title of पुरूरवस्, ययाति and कार्तवीर्य;
1: M. १३. ६२; ४३. २३; वा. ९६. १९०.
attained by शमिक.
2: M. ४६. २८.
For some more names see वा। प्।
3: वा. ३२, ३८, ५४; ६१. ८०, ८६-88; ९९. १५, १२७.
--to punish evil doers and to protect the law abiding. M. २११. 9.
--the capital of Malla whom कृष्ण van- quished; the palace of. Br. III. ७३. १००; IV. १४. ११.
--a sacred place in कीकट. वा. १०८. ७३.
--also क्षत्रधर्म; no sin to kill one in war. M. १०३. २२.

--ety. दण्डधारिन्; crimes escaping his notice are dealt with by Yama. In Kali the king is mostly of the fourth caste and takes the profession of robbery rather than protection. Earth loses its fertility. The wealth and wives of others are coveted; म्लेच्छस् are patronised. Duties-- salutation to cows and Brahmanas, sandhya worship and gifts to the deserving; not to deprive forcibly a Brahmana of his property;
1: Br. II. २९. ६३-64; ३१. ४१-156; ३६. १५६; III. २८. १०-74.
renowned kings get the title of राजऋषि, gene- rally of the family of Manu, Aila, इक्ष्वाकु.
2: Ib. II. ३५. ९०, ९६-102; III. ७१. १९४.
--six-fold; learnt by राम and कृष्ण. भा. X. ४५. ३४.
--१० dhanus broad; permits of easy move- ment for men, horses, chariots and elephants. वा. 8. ११९.
(I)--a name of Budha, the son of राजसोम and the originator of the science of elephantology. M. २४. 3.

(II)--prince; special teachers are to be appointed to teach him Dharma, Artha and काम s4a1stras, to train him in elephant riding, chariot riding, and in arts and crafts; he must have his bodyguard so that he may not mix with the undesirables and may control his senses; he [page३-065+ ३५] must live in a private residence, for an ill-disciplined prince will root out the family.
1: M. २२०. 1-6
A possible internal enemy of the king.
2: Ib. २२३. 9.
--a work on elephantology by the sage राजपुत्र, identified with Budha. M. २४. 3.

--police officials;
1: वा. १०१. १५४.
go to hell.
2: Br. IV. 2. १५५.
--unfit for श्राद्ध. Vi. III. १६. 7.
--smitten by this, Soma was relieved by his father, Atri. Br. III. ६५. ४६-8.
--to be worshipped in house-building. M. २५३. ३०, ४२; २६८. २३.

--devices for the protection of the king's person; different kinds of mixtures of medicines used for १५ days, one month, etc.; remedies to avert houses being consumed by fire; against snakes by burning their coating; examination of cooked food by giving it to birds or throw- ing it into the fire and then examining the change in colour; [page३-066+ २७] flies would not sit on the poisoned food; its effect on birds and beasts; the same is applicable to drinking water; such protection needed since he is the root of the tree of the people. M. २१९. 1-३४.
--the abode of Kubera. M. ८३. ४५.

--the giver of gift; kalpa tree becomes so in the next birth;
1: M. १०१. ३०, ५४, ७१; २७७. २१.
for the gift of gosahasra.
2: Ib. २७८. २५.
--the special title awarded by ब्रह्मा to Soma. Br. III. ६५. २०; वा. ९०. २०.
--a कश्यप and a त्रयार्षेय. M. १९९. १२.
--son of Dama, and father of Suvrddhi. Vi. IV. 1. ३६-7.
--son of Dyutimat. Vi. I. १०. 5.
--followed by robbers as the kings themselves begin to rob in the Kali age. वा. ५८. ४२.
--sacred to ललितापीठ. Br. IV. ४४. ९६.
--for wrong entry in, punished with uttama दण्ड. M. २२७. २०२. [page३-067+ ३४]

--otherwise known as केतुमान्, a लोकपाल;
1: Br. II. २१. १५७; M. १२४. ९५.
attained heaven by तपस्।
2: Ib. १४३. ३८.
--a king of Vidarbha. His daughter was married to Malayadhvaja पाण्ड्य. भा. IV. २८. २८-29.
--also प्रजाकरी; this quality possessed by मरीचि Kas4yapa. वा. ६६. ८७, १०४, १०५.
--intervening both satva and tama; leads to karma and rebirth and hence duhkha or misery due to ear, eye, tongue, body and smell. वा. १०२. ५४, ६२.

(I)--the conqueror of cardinal points was fit to perform this: युधिष्ठीर on this, to कृष्ण: Done by Soma who conquered the three worlds;
1: भा. X. ७१. 2[1]; ७२-3; IX. १४. 4; वा. ९०. २२.
युधिष्ठिर's desire to be a पारमेष्ठी. So ऋत्विक्स् were sent for, including भीष्म, Vidura. Even शूद्रस् were invited. After the sacrifice, on the suggestion of Sahadeva, the first honour was given to कृष्ण. शिशुपाल's protest and vilification of कृष्ण who had his head cut off. In the sacrifice each brother was assigned specific functions--Duryodhana in charge of treasury, भीम cooking, Nakula the supply of provisions, etc. The अवभृत bath at गन्गा accompanied by divine music. Every visitor duly honoured, returned back. Jealousy of Duryodhana at the success of the sacrifice.
2: भा. VII. 1. १३;; X. ७०. ४१; Chh. ७४-75.
The consecration ceremony of a king done by पृथु, वालि and others.
3: Br. II. ३६. ११३; III. 7. २६८; 8. २५; ६३. ११६; ७२. २८; वा. ६२. ९५; ७०. २१.
[page३-068+ ३४]
(III)--the fifth गान्धार gra1mika. वा. ८६. ४२.

--the gift of ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण equal to the performance of १००० sacrifices.
1: M. ५३. ५७.
The fruits of this यज्ञ are equal to fasting and praying to विष्णु on the अक्षयतृतीय day;
2: Ib. ६५. 7.
a plunge in the प्रयागा is equal to this यज्ञ।
3: Ib. १०६. २१.
Sacrifice performed by Soma when विष्णु was ब्रह्मा, शिव, the protector, Atri, the hota, भृगु, the अध्वर्यु, ब्रह्मा, the उद्गात, Sanaka and others were the Sadasyas, ten विश्वेदेवस् Camasa1dhvaryavas, and the three worlds दक्षिण; after this sacrifice the nine देवीस्, लक्ष्मी, सिनिवाली, कीर्ती, Vasu, धृती and others left their husbands and sported with Soma who acted as their consort;
4: Ib. २३. १९-27; ५८. ५४; २३९. ३७; Vi. IV. 6. 8.
the title of Soma after the राजसूय.
5: वा. ९०. २६.
--a son of शम्भु. Br. III. 5. ४०.
--a son of विदूरथ and a hero; had two sons शोणाश्व and श्वेतवाहन equal to gods. M. ४४. ७७-8.
--the first kings of the earth were Priyavrata and उत्तानपाद, sons of Manu; wielders of दण्ड; ety. of. वा. ५७. ५८.
--a pupil of कृत. Br. II. ३५. ५१; Vi. ६१. ४४.
--a Janapada of the केतुमाला continent. वा. ४४. १४.
--a horse of the moon's chariot. वा. ५२. ५३.

--the collective name for the hundred sons of Raji; the latter won over the Asuras and finally established Indra on the throne and retired for penance; his sons deprived Indra of his power when the latter appealed to बृहस्पति; he increased Indra's strength by rituals and made the राजेयस् adopt the जीनधर्म and hence got outside the pale of the Veda, when Indra easily overcame them and got back his kingdom; beginning of जीन dharma and hetu- वाद. M. २४. ३५-49.

--a kingdom; if a king has no legitimate suc- cessor, it changes hands; ruled by ministry in the king's absence; is concerned with two main things (बाह्य) or foreign affairs and (abhyantara) or home policy;
1: Br. III. ५०. २९-51; वा. ८८. ९४; ११२. १४. ४६.
of पृथु, described.
2: M. 1. ११; १०. १०-35.
[page३-070+ २८]
--son of Dama, and father of सुधृति. भा. IX. 2. २९; Br. III. 8. ३५.
--son of भजमान. वा. ९६. १३५.
--one of the three wives of विवस्वान्; she was the daughter of Raivata and had a son Revata. M. ११. 2-3.
